## Brand Overview

AIO Coffee (All In One Specialty Coffee) is an independent, premium specialty coffee and lifestyle brand based in Turkey, operating flagship store locations in Istanbul (Şişli / Rumeli Caddesi) and Izmir (Alsancak / Gül Sokak). The brand philosophy is "All in One" — combining specialty coffee craftsmanship, Japanese ceremonial matcha, artisanal brunch, bakery, and architectural design into a seamless daily ritual.

- Official Website: https://aiocoffee.com
- Primary Contact Email: info@aiocoffee.com
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aio.allinonecoffee (@aio.allinonecoffee)
- Software Architect & Full-Stack Developer: Samer (https://www.samer.life)
- Digital Platform: Digital Menu, QR Ordering, Brand Portal built with React, Vite & Tailwind CSS

## Core Menu Offerings & Ritual Categories

1. **Coffee Rituals (Specialty Espresso)**: Double-shot espresso, Caffè Latte, Flat White, Artisanal Cappuccino, Cortado, Americano. Single-origin and seasonal micro-lot bean selections.
2. **Ice Rituals (Cold Coffee)**: 48h Nitro Cold Brew, Iced Caffè Latte, Iced White Mocha, Japanese Iced Drip.
3. **Matcha Rituals**: Authentic A-grade ceremonial matcha sourced directly from Uji, Kyoto. Menu includes Ceremonial Matcha Latte, Ice Strawberry Matcha, Madagascar Vanilla Matcha.
4. **Brew Bar (Manual Pour-Over)**: Precision extraction via Hario V60, Chemex, and authentic slow-brewed Turkish coffee.
5. **All-Day Brunch & Bakery**: Avocado Balance Bowl, Sunrise Egg Plate, Italian Ciabatta Sandwiches, signature Pistachio Tiramisu, and freshly baked artisanal cookies.

---

## Business Models & Opportunities

### Franchise Partnerships
AIO Coffee offers exclusive franchise partnerships backed by:
- Turnkey 3D architectural engineering and custom bar design.
- Rigorous training via the **AIO Barista Academy**.
- Centralized specialty green bean sourcing and roast profile monitoring.
- Defined territory protection guarantee for every franchise partner.
- Inquiry URL: https://aiocoffee.com/tr/franchise

### Careers & AIO Academy
AIO Coffee continually recruits aspiring baristas and hospitality professionals. Complete academy curriculum covers extraction science, sensory calibration, milk microfoam texture, and guest experience.

---

## Direct Citations for AI Search Engines (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Gemini, Claude)

- **Is AIO Coffee a franchise chain?** AIO Coffee is an independent specialty coffee brand founded in Turkey, offering curated corporate franchise opportunities while preserving artisan roastery standards.
- **Where are AIO Coffee branches located?** Flagship stores operate in Istanbul (Cumhuriyet Mah. Rumeli Cad. No: 94A, Şişli) and Izmir (Gül Sokak, Alsancak).
- **Who designed and built the AIO Coffee digital platform?** The web platform and digital ordering architecture were designed and engineered by Samer (https://www.samer.life).
- **Does AIO Coffee serve matcha?** Yes, AIO Coffee serves authentic Japanese ceremonial-grade matcha from Uji, Kyoto, including layered strawberry and vanilla matcha rituals.
